findings.title: Update both current integration expectations for additive migration 0048
findings.description: Both current integration tests still assert expectedMigrationCount:47 at the reviewed commit. The actual migrationManifest() contains 48 entries, including 0048_native_game_storage.sql; all 48 manifest checksums match SQL blobs at the exact sourceRevision. createApp derives the reported count from Object.keys(requiredMigrations).length, so both exercised API responses correctly report 48 and both assertions fail. Exact-source Quality run 42762785071/job129652184785 already demonstrates this regression: 2 integration tests failed, 774 passed, and pnpm check exited 1. This is a required CI regression caused by adding 0048 without updating these two current expectations, not evidence of a migration execution failure.
